240-3899-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

883-1263-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
883-1263-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-1339-1940.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-1339-1940.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1339-2425-3899.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

7850-7944.description:
Whenever a nontoken creature enters that was cast, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling that creature.
Whenever a nontoken creature enters that wasn't cast, it is instead exiled due to Containment Priest. This also applies to any creatures that would be put onto the battlefield by Mirror of Life Trapping.

851-2557-4365-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1619-4605-5542-6138-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6138-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6138-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2452-3249-5670-7399--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

891-2511-2843.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3284-3490-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1315-3234-3293-6797.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-6797.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-6797.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1495-4613-6843-6861.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Sawhorn Nemesis.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1580-4871-5921-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with Mana Cost Equal to {0}

3182-3676-5751-6753--1.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
3182-3676-5751-6753--1.description:
Cast the creature with mana cost {0} from your graveyard for its retrace cost by discarding a land card.
Tangleroot and Turntimber Sower trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Turntimber Sower trigger, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G}, sacrificing the {0} cost creature and sacrificing the two Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1414-2051-4970-5751-6747.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two land cards in your hand.
1414-2051-4970-5751-6747.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {G}, returning at least two land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more ingredient counters on it

215-2060-6675.manaNeeded: {2} plus at least two mana of different colors
215-2060-6675.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, using as many different colors of mana as possible.
Communal Brewing triggers, causing Crystalline Crawler to enter with at least two additional +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Crystalline Crawler spell, causing it to enter with a number of +1/+1 counters.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat step 4 until Crystalline Crawler has no +1/+1 counters on it, adding as many colors of mana as possible.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-2060-6675.notes: You should use any many colors as possible while casting Crystalline Crawler so it will enter with as many +1/+1 counters as possible. The starting mana cost may change depending on what mana you use to cast Crystalline Crawler initially, adding up to an additional {1}{G} for the first iteration. This can also be reduced if Communal Brewing has more ingredient counters on it.

5104-6527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven tokens.
5104-6527.description:
Cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Nadier's Nightblade triggers for each token you control that leaves the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least 7 life and you to gain at least 7 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3122-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Undercover Operative has a power of at least 2.
1912-3122-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Undercover Operative and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Undercover Operative from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Undercover Operative to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Undercover Operative enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Undercover Operative by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2741-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2741-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

141-2921-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1383-4067-4343.notablePrerequisites:
You have exactly one card in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
1383-4067-4343.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping target creature an opponent controls.
Hylda of the Icy Crown triggers, causing you to pay {1} to scry 2 and draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

2034-2499-3089-4840.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar five times by sacrificing five Myrs, adding ten {C}.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing a Myr, returning Myr Battlesphere to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

643-1424-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
643-1424-2534.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

335-3629.notablePrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
335-3629.description:
Cast Ad Nauseam by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Resolve Ad Nauseam, revealing the top card of your library, putting that card into your hand and losing life equal to that card's mana value.
Repeat the process in step 2 as many times as desired.

539-3467-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Devoted Druid.
539-3467-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving Devoted Druid +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1411-1725.description:
At the beginning of each player's draw step, Omen Machine triggers, exiling the top card of their library, and putting the card onto the battlefield if it's a land, or causing its owner to cast it without paying its mana cost otherwise.
Because Soulless Jailer prevents noncreature spells from being cast from exile, no player may cast noncreature spells as permitted by Omen Machine.

283-2954-4067.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Ormos.
You have at least three cards in hand with different names.
You control an Island.
283-2954-4067.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Ormos by paying {1}{U}{U} and discarding three cards with different names.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ormos' ability.
Resolve both Ormos abilities, causing you to draw ten cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discading a card, untapping the Island.
Activate the Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1124-1887-3258-3326-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a Planeswalker spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1124-1887-3258-3326-5131.description:
Cast Kasmina from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}{G}.
Kasmina enters the battlefield with four loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kasmina's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it due to Vorinclex, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Kasmina's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it.
Kasmina dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Kasmina ability, causing you to search for library for Beacon of Tomorrows, exile it, then cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Beacon of Tomorrows, allowing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

618-4125-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Shipwreck Dowser triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The token copy of Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

774-3478-4826.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Dimir Aqueduct triggers, targeting itself.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Dimir Aqueduct for {U}{B}.
Allow the trigger to resolve, returning Dimir Aqueduct to your hand.
Repeat.
